Independent polarity defense: for each candidate scan ALL documents for a positive assignment to the requested role. Counter requires an explicit negative/exclusion or incompatible statement about that exact referent, and cannot be justified by absence. A birth header (date1 - date2) supports date1, not merely prose Born on. Distinct people sharing a name, distinct works with one title, multiple sports and plural mascots may legitimately coexist. Role match and truth are separate axes: competing same-role values stay direct with conflict flagged. Unknown memory is not negative evidence. Recheck all wrong_argument labels against the source before returning.
